title: TriadicFrameworks MCP Authentication Token
description: Token definition for authentication in the Origin Layer (0D) of the TriadicFrameworks MCP cosmology.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

token.description: Authentication token issued by the MCP server. May be JWT or opaque depending on server configuration.

issuedAt.description: Timestamp when the token was issued.

clientId.description: Identifier of the client to whom the token was issued.

scope.description: List of capabilities granted by this token.

interpretation.technical: Token contains all required fields and valid timestamps.
interpretation.mythic: The observer is granted passage; the gate of origin recognizes the signature.

interpretation.technical: The token's expiration timestamp is in the past.
interpretation.mythic: The signal has faded; the origin layer no longer hears the observer.
